name: Specimunk
match_rationale: Demonstrates converting a handwritten image into text, directly illustrating the canonical recognition task.
scope_label: Educational OCR example, not the museum's documented architecture
why_workbooks_insufficient: All 360 lesson bodies were reviewed; none teaches OCR, handwriting recognition, or transcription. Generic image detection is not character recognition, and no museum model architecture is documented to justify choosing a specific workbook architecture.
limitations: TrOCR is an illustrative method, not a claim about the museum project. Scientific labels and field extraction require additional domain validation; documentation is code-oriented.

name: Parcelprawn
article_title: Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
relevant_topic: Routes constrained by service time windows
match_rationale: Shows how travel times and required visit windows constrain routes, directly illustrating delivery scheduling.
scope_label: Time-window routing component, not a full real-time delivery service
why_workbooks_insufficient: No preferred lesson teaches delivery stop sequences or operational time windows. Gradient optimization, token routing, and DAG ordering do not represent vehicle-routing constraints.
limitations: The worked example does not include every capacity, labor, map-quality, or live-traffic concern in canonical limitations; code is more advanced than a lay introduction.

name: Wardray
match_rationale: Models nurse coverage and shift constraints, a concrete hospital scheduling component using a canonical technique family.
scope_label: Staff-allocation component, not all hospital resources or emergency care
why_workbooks_insufficient: Preferred lessons teach neural optimization, pipeline dependencies, or mention MILP for robustness, but not operational staffing constraints. Forecast features alone do not teach assignments.
limitations: Does not model beds, equipment, triage, or emergency replanning; examples are educational, not clinical instructions or evidence of a local deployment.

name: Cabcrab
publisher: Daniel Jurafsky and James H. Martin, Speech and Language Processing (Stanford-hosted draft)
relevant_topic: Task-oriented dialogue, slots, state, and confirmation
match_rationale: Teaches collecting travel details through dialogue and confirming the intended task, closely matching booking-request interpretation.
scope_label: Task-oriented dialogue component, not GoDurham's implemented architecture
why_workbooks_insufficient: No preferred lesson teaches booking slots, dialogue-state tracking, or confirmation. Generic LLM and prompt-security material would imply an unsupported architecture or explain a different task.
limitations: An illustrative frame-based design, not proof that GoDurham uses it. The current book links this appendix; PDF navigation is less mobile-friendly than HTML.

name: Routeopus
match_rationale: Explains route costs, fleet constraints, and routing problem types, directly supporting the canonical routing component.
scope_label: Vehicle-routing foundation, not a complete public-transit dispatch system
why_workbooks_insufficient: No preferred lesson teaches operational vehicle routing. Neural expert routing, HTTP routing, and pipeline scheduling are unrelated; time-series inputs do not determine feasible routes.
limitations: Introductory rather than a transit timetable tutorial; does not establish service equity, accessibility, live traffic handling, or a specific operator's technology.

name: Shiftshark
match_rationale: Demonstrates assigning workers under coverage, workload, and preference constraints, directly matching the canonical scheduling job.
scope_label: Constrained shift-assignment component, not a fairness guarantee
why_workbooks_insufficient: No preferred lesson substantively teaches worker assignment or shift-coverage constraints. Data-pipeline ordering and neural optimizer updates do not fill this gap.
limitations: Educational constraints are simplified; labor rules, skills, demand uncertainty, and fairness still need explicit modeling. Sharing Wardray's URL does not share owner approval.
